capture_method: Preview File > Take Screenshot > Entire Screen, operated through CUA
pixel_check: ImageIO/CoreGraphics decoded RGBA8; near white means R, G and B each >=245. Both horizontal edge strips were checked to avoid bitmap row-origin ambiguity.
visual_observation: Game fills native display capture edges. CUA window capture shows white top/right margins.
conclusion: White margins belong to the CUA window-capture path; native whole-display capture does not contain them.
limitations: Native capture contains Screenshot toolbar/selection and desktop overlays; raw image remains local.
Underlying CUA internal implementation was not changed or identified.
Native capture in this follow-up is the normal app; cheat fullscreen geometry was covered by the prior 33-test run.
